text:
alex.p: Heads-up — recruiting flagged a comp-band exception for candidate (IC4 -> IC5). Need approvals before we push the offer. Details: base $210k, bonus 10%, equity 0.5%.
lisa.recruiter: Candidate prefers a 4/20 start. Can we meet that? They have a 4-week notice period and multiple offers in flight.
jamie.hr: Tagging comp-approvals. Need manager justification + budget sign-off. @sara.pm can you paste the biz case and expected impact?
sara.pm: Short justification: critical infra ownership for our real-time routing project, 5+ yrs infra experience, strong SRE background. We lost two prior candidates at IC4. Recommend IC5 to retain. Budget noted — we can absorb in Q2 hiring buffer.
eric.finance: Confirming budget — we have headroom but per policy a comp-band exception needs director-level sign-off + finance acknowledgement. cc @maria.dir for director approval.
maria.dir: Approved from director level to escalate to comp committee if hiring manager commits to a 6-month performance review and clear success criteria. I can sign off on exception contingent on that.
approvals-bot: Routing request to Compensation Committee queue. Estimated SLA: 48h. Routing path: manager -> director -> finance -> comp-committee. Ticket ID: CCQ-2026-1842.
jamie.hr: Can we expedite? Candidate expects response within 24h. Two options: 1) fast-track committee (request urgent review) or 2) offer at IC4 band top plus a retention bonus bridging the cash gap. Which do we prefer?
sara.pm: I prefer full IC5; recruiting risk is high. If committee can't greenlight in 24h, approve retention bonus fallback. Marking priority: urgent :rotating_light:
maria.dir: I'll escalate to committee chair. Also OK to approve interim retention bonus of $10k (one-time) as fallback to hold candidate.
jamie.hr: Good. I'll open the urgent comp-committee escalation and prepare an interim offer template. Draft clause I'll use:
```
Offer is contingent on final comp-committee approval. If a comp-band exception is not approved, the company will provide a one-time retention payment to align total cash with the agreed offer, subject to standard onboarding and employment terms.
```
Posting escalation now and emailing candidate a tentative offer window.
lisa.recruiter: Thanks — I'll tell the candidate we're aiming for 4/20 start pending final sign-off and that there's an expedited review. Will collect signed offer ASAP and keep you posted.
ajex.p: Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick turnaround :thumbsup:
